Robot Name Generator

Generate robot identities — model numbers (RX-7742), unit designations, or friendly bot names for your machines.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a style: model number, designation, or friendly name.
  2. Choose how many to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any result to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between the styles?

Model numbers use series prefixes like RX, MK, AX plus random digits (e.g. RX-7742); designations add a friendly nickname.

What is a designation style?

Unit designations combine a label like “Unit JX-9” with a callsign nickname in quotes.

How do I copy a result?

Click any result or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
